passage.label: Hour appointment more disastrous bitter; indeed criminals error madness; Day dragged Fire faces taste touch Saqar; indeed all things created predestination; command one glance eye; already destroyed kinds will remember; everything did written records; every small great inscribed; indeed righteous among gardens rivers; seat honor near Sovereign Perfect Ability

arabicExcerpts.text: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ

mainSubject.label: The Hour named as their appointed punishment, more disastrous and bitter than any worldly defeat; criminals identified as being in error and madness; dragged into the Fire on their faces and told to taste Saqar's touch; all things created with predestination and divine command executed in a single glance; prior kinds destroyed as reminder; every deed recorded in writing, small and great inscribed; the righteous placed among gardens and rivers in a seat of honour near the Sovereign Perfect in Ability

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the Quran-ease reminder (17) before the Aad narrative opens (18); P2 ends with the second Quran-ease reminder after Thamud (32) before Lot's people begin (33); P3 runs through Lot, Pharaoh and the assembly-defeat declaration (33-45); P4 covers the Hour appointment, Saqar, predestination, records and the righteous reward (46-55).
